products.title: P Series PWM Receiver
products.body_html:
Engineered for fixed-wing aircraft, RC helicopters, cars, boats, and more, the P Series PWM Receivers combine reliable ExpressLRS 2.4 GHz connectivity with long-range performance and flexible configuration. PWM outputs, CRSF/SBUS serial output, and voltage telemetry provide versatile control and essential flight data. Choose the P6D or P8D for true diversity reception powered by dual SX1281 chips and dual antennas—ideal for larger models and demanding flights. For builds where space and weight matter most, the compact, lightweight P4 and P6 are the perfect fit.

Bullet Points

  • Versatile Compatibility: For fixed-wing aircraft, RC helicopters, cars, boats, and more.
  • ExpressLRS 2.4 GHz: Reliable connectivity and long-range performance for confident control.
  • Flexible Outputs: PWM outputs and CRSF/SBUS serial output support a wide range of setups.
  • Voltage Telemetry: Monitor voltage in real time to stay informed during operation.
  • P6D & P8D True Diversity: Dual SX1281 chips and dual antennas provide dependable reception, with 100 mW telemetry power.
  • Compact P4 & P6: Weighing just 2.05g and 2.72g without antennas, respectively—ideal for builds where space and weight matter.

P6D & P8D: Reliable True Diversity

Powered by dual SX1281 chips, P6D and P8D 2.4G RX feature two independent RF channels and dual antennas for dependable reception across a wide range of aircraft orientations. With 100 mW telemetry power, they deliver reliable connectivity for large RC aircraft, long-range flights, and complex aerobatic maneuvers.

P4 & P6: Compact and Lightweight

Weighing just 2.05 g (P4) and 2.72 g (P6) without antenna, these compact receivers keep weight to a minimum. They are ideal for F3P indoor aerobatic aircraft, F3K hand-launch gliders, indoor RC helicopters, and other builds that demand a small, lightweight receiver.

Bind

The Receiver uses ExpressLRS V3.x official protocol as its default firmware without a pre-set binding phrase. For successful operation, ensure the transmitter module also uses ExpressLRS V3.x or later firmware with no pre-set binding phrase.

  1. Power-cycle the receiver 3 times with a 1-second interval to enter binding mode.
  2. The RGB indicator flashes orange twice, which indicates the receiver is in bind mode.
  3. Configure remote control or transmitter module to bind with the receiver. If the RGB indicator is a solid light, it's bound!

Notes:

● After binding once, the receiver will remember the autosaved binding phrase and device. Further restarting of the device will be bound automatically without the need for a rebinding process.

● If you have flashed firmware to the receiver and configured the binding phrase, you will not be able to bind using the method above. Please set the same binding phrase for the transmitter module, this allows the receiver to be bound to the device automatically.

● It is recommended to place the two antennas as far apart as possible for better reception.

Know More About ExpressLRS

ExpressLRS is an open-source RC link for RC applications. Everyone could find this project on Github or join the discussion in Facebook Group.

products.title: F4 1S 12A AIO Brushless Flight Controller
products.body_html:
The SPI FrSky with Motor Connectors version features connectors soldered to the sides at a 90° angle, as shown below.

What is the update of the ELRS 2.4G V2.0 board?

  • Support both 1S and 2S battery now. Only 1S supported on V1.0.
  • Use SPI ExpressLRS 2.4 receiver with Betaflight firmware.
  • Modify the shape of the board to support 85mm whoop frame. Only toothpick frame supported on V1.0.
  • Use the lighter and smaller SH connector instead of USB Type-C.

F4 1S 12A AIO Flight Controller - A 1S 12A FC for building lightweight 3" toothpick drones like HX115 SE Toothpick Drone and HX115 LR Toothpick Drone. If you want to try a bigger FPV drone than 65mm/75mm on 1S power, and still want smooth and powerful flying actions, this FC that integrates 1S 12A ESC is definitely your best choice.

Now the default firmware for F4 1S 12A AIO Brushless Flight Controller is updated to Betaflight V4.3.0 Official version, which supports ELRS V2.0. Please check the below link to download the firmware.

Download the betaflight_4.3.0_BETAFPVF4SX1280.hex

Tons of ExpressLRS items are available now!

Bullet Point

  • F4 1S 12A AIO Flight Controller is the best choice for building ultra-lightweight 3" toothpick drones like HX115 SE FPV Quad.
  • Most of the 1S flight controllers on the market come with 5A ESC by now, but this FC especially integrates 1S 12A ESC, it can provide more sufficient power for 3" toothpick drones.
  • Built-in current meter, 2 programmable RGB LEDs, and SPI Frsky receiver. At the same time, all the pads are left for the external receivers with UART1 and UART2, for buzzers, etc.
  • Whoop mounting hole pattern, be compatible with most 1S 3" frames. Large pads are reserved for solder motor cables, this design will make solder easier.

Specification of FC

  • Item: F4 1S 12A AIO FC
  • Weight: 4.74 g (without power cable and BT2.0 connector)
  • CPU: STM32F411CEU6 (100MHZ )
  • Six-Axis: MPU6000 (SPI connection)
  • Firmware version: betaflight_4.2.0_STM32F411
  • OSD: Built-in BetaFlight OSD (STM32 controls OSD chip over SPI in DMA mode)
  • Receiver: Integrated SPI Frsky Receiver / Futaba Receiver / ELRS Receiver
  • Motor Pin Connecter: 1.25mm Header Pins
  • Mounting Hole Size: 26mm x 26mm (suitable for whoop pattern mounting hole)
  • USB Port: Type-C (V1.0 board), SH1.0 4-Pin (V2.0 board)

Specification of 1S 12A ESC

  • Built-in ESC with 12A continuous and peak 25A current
  • Input voltage: 1S Lipo (V1.0 board), 1S-2S (V2.0 board)
  • ESC firmware: Z_H_30_REV16_7.HEX
  • Signal support: D-shot150, D- shot300, D-shot600, Oneshot125, Multishot, PWM

This new BLHeli_S firmware (named Z_H_30_REV16_7.HEX) is supported by BLHeli Configurator, BLHeliSuite, and Bluejay Configurator for setup.

For download and flash, update to the newest BLHeliSuite-16714902a to support this ESC firmware online. For BLHeli Configurator or Bluejay Configurator, you need to load it local. The ESC firmware is available for download here.

Diagram for F4 1S 12A AIO FC

Below is the diagram for the SPI Frsky version board. UART1, UART2, and SBUS pads are left for external receivers like Frsky XM+, TBS Nano receiver so that a long receiver range is available.

Buzz pads (BUZZ+ and BUZZ-) are invalid directly. It needs some modification to make it works.

Below is the diagram for ELRS 2.4G V1.0 board.

Below is the diagram for ELRS 2.4G V2.0 board.

The current meter is integrated on the FC board. Here is the configuration in Betaflight Configurator.

12A 1S ESC

Should we really need a 12A ESC for 1S drones? If it is a 65mm or 75mm Whoop drone-like Meteor65, 5A ESC is enough for all actions. But how about with 3" propellers and 1102/1202.5 motors? Still, want smooth and powerful flying actions? The 5A ESC has developed about 3 years ago and was designed for whoop drones with 0603/0802 motors. For the past year, the BETAFPV team has been cooperating with BLHeli author Steffen on the 12A 1S ESC for 3" toothpick drones. Finally, it is here!

It marks "1-2S" on the board, could this FC board support 2S?

The V1.0 board is NOT support 2S battery. Please choose the V2.0 board for both 1S and 2S battery supported.

ELRS 2.4G RX

This board integrates the receiver with the most popular radio link ExpressLRS in 2021. ExpressLRS aims to achieve the best possible link performance in both speeds, latency, and range. Know more about the ExpressLRS project on Github or join the discussion in the Facebook Group.

This board is designed for long-range 3inch ultralight toothpick drones or 2S whoop drones. If you want to try ExpressLRS on 65mm/75mm whoop drones, please stay tuned on our F4 1S FC board with a built-in SPI ExpressLRS receiver.

How to Bind with Betaflight FC with ExpressLRS Receiver.

How to update the ELRS RX on the AIO board. (For ELRS 2.4G V1.0 version, ELRS receiver communicates with FC F411 via CRSF protocol. )

CLI command for the FC board.

Betaflight Firmware and CLI (SPI ELRS 2.4G)

This paragraph is only for ELRS 2.4G V2.0 board, with SPI ELRS 2.4G receiver integrated.

Since Betaflight has not yet released the official firmware that could supports the SPI ExpressLRS protocol, the current version is the Beta version. Please use the firmware and the CLI dump file below to recovery the FC board if needed. Betaflight will update to their official target soon. Please feel free to contact with us if you have any issues with this Beta version Firmware.

It is normal that there is no any option on Betaflight Configurator Receiver. As show below, the checkbox is blank.

Please change the “PID loop frequency” to “4KHZ” , sometimes it would make the SPI receiver not working correct while the value is “8KHZ”.

New released firmware BTFL_4.3.0_BETAFPVF4SX1280_0265565fa uses external GPIO interrupt triggers to process ELRS data reception, increasing the stability of the signal link. Now it can perfectly support LiteRadio 2 SE 500Hz link and modify the accuracy of signal strength. 

The new CLI file is named BTFL_cli_F4 12A ELRS_V2.0_NEW. Please check.

Note: The new firmware supports only ELRS 1.0.0, 1.0.1, 1.1.0, 1.2.0, 1.2.1.

Download the firmware and CLI dump file for the F4 1S 12A FC (ELRS 2.4G) board.

More details and discussion on Github about SPI ELRS receiver.

SPI Frsky RX

Come with the build-in SPI Frsky Receiver (CC2500 chip), F4 1S 12A AIO FC can be compatible with Futaba S-FHSS, Frsky D8, and D16 protocol. The default protocol is configured to Frsky D16 FCC out of the factory. Pilots could set up the protocol according to your own need in Betaflight Configurator.

products.title: [BETA TEST] NexRadio 14 Radio Controller
products.body_html:
The NexRadio 14 Radio Controller BETA TEST version has been out of stock, thanks for your participation and support!

Test it and share your feedback here. We’d love to hear your thoughts on grip comfort, ease of operation, DCS gimbal performance, and more. The design, core functions, and hardware are close to final, though minor issues may remain during beta testing. Your feedback will help us refine the experience and bring your ideas to life.

Meet the NexRadio 14—NexRadio’s first radio controller and the first to feature digital capacitive sensor gimbals. Built for precise control, reliable connectivity, and lasting comfort, it packs powerful performance into a compact, ergonomic design. Powered by an STM32H5 MCU and EdgeTX, it pairs NexRadio DCS gimbals with a dual-band ELRS Gemini-X TX module for smooth, responsive flying. Dual screens put essential information at a glance, while smart power management and modular construction support longer sessions and easy customization.

    Bullet Points

    • Powerful EdgeTX Platform: STM32H5 MCU delivers high performance with the flexibility of EdgeTX.
    • Compact, Ergonomic Design: Refined grips offer a comfortable, secure hold, while foldable dual-band antennas simplify storage.
    • Modular Construction: Designed for easier expansion, upgrades, and customization.
    • NexRadio DCS Gimbals: Digital capacitive sensing with ultra-high precision, anti-interference, infinite lifespan and smart sampling provides smooth, accurate control. Now available!
    • ELRS Gemini-X Connectivity: Dual LR1121 chips support dual 1W 900 MHz + 2.4 GHz GemX operation and ELRS packet rates up to 1,000 Hz.
    • Dedicated ELRS Screen: Alongside the main EdgeTX display, a dedicated ELRS screen provides convenient access to settings and real-time Gemini-X TX combination status.
    • Smart Power Management: Use while charging, with reverse-polarity, charge, and discharge protection.
    • Efficient Cooling: A CNC-machined cooling system supports stable TX module operation at high output power.
    • Refined Details: Clear digital audio, built-in 256 Mb SD NAND storage, and a tactile power button enhance the user experience.

products.title: Beta95X V3 Whoop Quadcopter (HD Digital VTX)
products.body_html:
Important Note: This product is new, unused, and functional, but has been stored for approximately three years. The battery may be swollen, over-discharged, or have low voltage. Product defects and performance issues are not covered under warranty.

We are glad to announce that the Beta95X V3 series drone is updated with huge improvements. The new changes could effectively reduce the issue of jello generated in the insane flight and provide a better FPV image.
  • Change the motor to 1404 4500KV Motor, it can effectively reduce the vibration of the fuselage during the flight.
  • Replace the D63 5-blade propellers with D63 3-Blade Props, which will have lower noise and less vibration during flight.

Comes with a brand new pusher design, equipped with Caddx Nebula Nano HD System, and supports to combine with the SMO 4K action camera, Beta95X V3 Whoop Quadcopter(HD Digital VTX) totally reinvents the traditional cinematic drones! It gives pilots an amazing HD flight experience, bringing pilots to a fairly clear image of every highlight moment!

If you are interested in the Analog version, we also launch the Beta95X V3 Whoop Quadcopter, and SMO 4K camera is also released too. 

Bullet Point

  • Beta95X V3 is perfectly suitable for the SMO 4K action camera. With a built-in camera mount and a power cable, it's very convenient for out-of-the-box installation and power input for the camera. Combining with SMO 4K, pilots can get a stable & high-quality video while in FPV flight.
  • Equipped with the nebula Nano HD System, perfectly supports the DJI HD system. This lightweight kit provides a stable FPV picture and long transmission distance, greatly bring you a unique flight experience.
  • Adopts a brand-new innovative pusher frame design, Beta95X V3 is more durable and easier for installation than Beta95X V2. The frame also comes with an EVA foam cushioning design to give you more safety flying.
  • Equipped with Toothpick F405 AIO 20A FC V4, 1404 4500KV motor, and D63 3-blade props, this highly efficient power system keeps Beta95X V3 more powerful and less noise in flight. For the battery, we highly recommend you using the BETAFPV 450mAh 4S battery to get the best flying experience.
  • Centering the drone's gravity by reversed-motor design and top battery place makes the drone more maneuverable to achieve all FPV freestyle tricks such as diving. 
  • Further improves the shock mitigation system to eliminate the shake of the camera, Beta95X V3 HD Digital VTX will make the camera more stable on the flight, which ensures pilots can capture all the beautiful moments of flight with the stabilized and clear video.

Specification

  • Item: Beta95X V3 (HD Digital VTX)
  • Weight: 116.7g (without battery)
  • Wheelbase: 95mm
  • FC: Toothpick F405 AIO 20A FC V4
  • Frame: Beta95X V3 Frame Kit
  • Motors: 1404 4500KV Brushless motor
  • Props: Gemfan D63 3-Blades Props
  • Receiver Option: Frsky FCC/Frsky LBT/TBS/PNP 
  • FPV Camera Degree: 25°- 45°
  • HD digital camera & VTX: Caddx Nebula Nano HD System
  • Camera Mount: SMO 4K camera Mount
  • HD Camera Mount Degree: 5°- 45° 
  • Antenna: Air 5.8GHz Antenna (LHCP)
  • Battery: 450mAh 4S battery(Not including) 
  • Charge Connector: XT30
  • Flight time: About 3.5 min flight with 450mAh 4S battery
  • Maximum take-off weight: 173g

 

BETAFPV SMO 4K Camera

SMO 4K camera, a high-degree lightweight action camera for FPV drones that is developed by BETAFPV using Insta360 technology. SMO 4K camera only weighs 30g and perfectly fit for FPV drones, and brings pilots an extraordinary flying experience and a strong visual impact. What's more, it almost compatible with all kinds of FPV drones like micro cinewhoop Beta95X V3, 3-4in the ducted quad, 4-5in long-range FPV drone, and fixed-wing. It will be the perfect action camera for pilots in search of high-quality video with FPV racing drones. 



Nebula Nano HD System

The Caddx Nebula Nano HD System can perfectly support with DJI goggles. With DJI goggles, it can provide 720p/60fps digital high-definition picture and a transmission range up to 4km. Users can choose 25mW/200mW/500mW/700mW from DJI goggle settings. The total weight (excluding antenna) is 24g only, about 26g lighter than the DJI FPV unit. Besides, it is smaller and designed for whoop drones. 

Beta95X V3 Pusher Frame

A newly designed pusher whoop frame - Beta95X V3 Frame is made of high-quality PA12 material, which can dampen noise and vibrations and have high abrasion resistance, bringing the drone a more durable flight and no fear of damage. Meanwhile, it also comes with an EVA foam cushioning design to give you more safety flying.  The pusher style puts all the cameras and batteries on the top of the platform, makes the center of gravity is right in the middle of the drone, brings the best fly operability. 

FC & ESC

Beta95X V3 series whoop drone is equipped with the new released Toothpick F405 AIO 20A FC V4, it extremely reduces the weight while improving the ability of the ESC to continuous current 20A, and brings pilots more power to fly the Beta95X V3 quad! Meanwhile, the new 20A FC V4 adds 2 pin connector ports for DJI Digital VTX and Rx, just plug & play, less solder work needed, super easy to install.


Please Note: The chip of F405 V4 flight controller's ESC has changed to AT32F415 from STM32F105 due to shortage. While the AT32F415 is applicable to the ESC firmware version BETAFPV_20A_AT32.

Motor & Props

Gemfan D63 3-Blades Props is designed for inverted installation, and it brings pilots a smooth flight! It is more durable and more powerful, offers pilots a high-efficiency flight experience. Equipped with the 1404 4500KV Brushless motor, it brings a stronger power and lower noise, which will give pilots an unprecedented flying experience.

The Beta95X V3(HD Digital VTX)  drone also comes with "props out" by default. Why we need "Props out" direction?

Default Betaflight props direction, quadcopter dips, and "washes out" in hard corners. With reversed props or "props out", no more dipping even in the hardest cornering.

Know more about "Props Out".

  • Power Supply – Now supports power supply directly from your goggles.
  • Optimized HDMI Cable – Upgraded from a straight connection to a 90° angled cable for a clean look.
  • Expanded Goggle Compatibility – Added support for Fat Shark Dominator HD3 and V3 (720P), with manual resolution switching required.
  • SMA Tightening Wheels – Includes 2 SMA wheels to easily secure loose antennas.
  • Extra Outer Casing – Each package includes a random color outer casing for custom builds.

The P1 HD VRX (Nano) is a compact digital video receiver compatible with the ArtLynk Protocol, designed to bring crystal‑clear HD FPV to your existing Fat Shark and SKYZONE goggles without adding unnecessary bulk. Simply connect it via the mini HDMI port to Fat Shark or SKYZONE goggles and enjoy a stunning 1080p@60fps live feed with low latency and reliable 400m+ range. With multi‑band switching for interference‑free video and a plug‑and‑play design, the P1 HD VRX Nano is the most affordable way to upgrade your FPV experience to digital HD.

Bullet Points

  • Compact, lightweight design – easy to install and carry
  • Compatible with Fat Shark & SKYZONE goggles via mini HDMI
  • 1080p@60fps smooth video · 400m+ reliable range
  • Multi‑band switching for interference‑free flying
  • Affordable digital HD upgrade – no full system replacement needed

Specifications

  • Dimensions (antenna excluded): 39*62*36mm (Fat Shark compatible version), 32*64*36mm (SKYZONE compatible version)
  • Weight (antenna excluded): 36g (Fat Shark compatible version), 33g (SKYZONE compatible version)
  • SD card slot: Support max 1TB
  • Frequency: 5.3-5.8GHz
  • Effective Isotropic Radiated Power (EIRP): <23dBm (FCC), <14dBm (CE)
  • Ports: Type-C, mini HDMI, micro SD card slot, 2Pin PH2.0 connector
  • Antenna connector: RP-SMA Female (external thread, inner hole)
  • Transmission resolution: 1080p@60fps
  • Bitrate: 25Mbps
  • Transmission range: ＞400m
  • Input voltage: 5.5-26.4V

    Dimensions

    Fat Shark compatible version:

    SKYZONE compatible version:

    Compact & Lightweight

    Designed to be unobtrusive on your existing goggles, the P1 HD VRX (Nano) is small, lightweight, and perfectly balanced for comfortable, long‑duration flying. No extra weight. No bulky hardware. Just crisp, clear HD video – fly as long as you like.

    Note: For a cleaner, more streamlined installation, we upgraded the standard straight cable to a 90° angled HDMI cable – now available in both Fat Shark and SKYZONE versions.

    Fat Shark & SKYZONE Compatible — Bring Your Classic Goggles Back to Life

    Available in two case sizes, the P1 HD VRX (Nano) is compatible with most Fat Shark (39×62×36mm) and SKYZONE (32×64×36mm) FPV goggles. Simply connect via the mini HDMI port to upgrade your existing goggles to a digital receiver – no need to invest in expensive digital goggles. It's the most affordable way to experience HD FPV with your current setup.

     Brand Compatible Models

    Fat Shark

    		 HDO+, HDO2, HDO, AttitudeV6, Dominator HD3, Dominator V3

    SKYZONE

    		 SKY04L, SKY04X, SKY04O, SKY04X PRO, SKY04O PRO

    Note: The previous incompatibility with Fat Shark Dominator HD3 and V3 has been resolved via a firmware update for the P1 HD VRX Nano. To work with these goggles, manually switch the resolution to 720P. Simply press and hold the 5D and Back buttons simultaneously for 5 seconds. Wait for the device to reboot – the resolution will switch automatically.

    Smooth, Reliable Video Transmission

    The P1 HD VRX supports 1080p@60fps video transmission with a stable 400m+ range and low latency for a smooth, immersive flying experience. Operating across the 5.3–5.8GHz frequency range, it allows you to switch channels to avoid interference, ensuring optimal transmission range and image quality even in crowded RF environments.

    How to Achieve Internal Power Supply

    During the Beta Test phase, Fat Shark goggles required an external power supply – a setup that pilots found inconvenient and bulky.

    So we worked with Fat Shark to make it better – and now both the P1 VRX Nano versions can now draw power directly from your goggles, eliminating the need for a separate power cable. Support varies by model – please check the compatibility details below.

     Brand Compatible Models What You Need to Do

    Fat Shark

    		 HDO+, HDO2, HDO, AttitudeV6, Dominator HD3 Disassemble and modify

    SKYZONE

    SKYZONE

    		 SKY04X PRO, SKY04O PRO No disassembly needed – just update firmware

    Detailed instructions are available:

    • Instructions for Fat Shark Internal Power Supply
    • Instructions for SKYZONE Internal Power Supply

    Know More About ArtLynk Protocol

    The ArtLynk protocol is a low-latency, long-range communication protocol for drones, offering superior stability and range over traditional analog VTX. ArtLynk protocol enables real-time HD video at about 60ms latency from glass to glass, which is crucial for smooth flight control and high-quality FPV (First Person View). Here are the key features you may want to know.

    • Artosyn Inside & KAP Supported: ArtLynk protocol uses the Artosyn's latest AR803X chipset, with core technology support provided by KAP (KAP company provides core technology support or product solution to all FPV companies and ensures compatibility for various FPV products using Artosyn chipsets).
    • Collaborative and Open Community: ArtLynk protocol is a collaborative FPV ecosystem not belonging to ONLY one company. Many FPV enterprises and teams would design and produce their own products based on the ArtLynk protocol, ensuring broad compatibility and fostering community.

    The ArtLynk protocol supports the following devices, letting you customize your own build or simply bind and fly:

    • BETAFPV P1 Air Unit, VR04 HD Goggles, Aquila20 P1, Meteor75 Pro P1, Monitor, P1 HD VRX (Standard), P1 HD VRX (Nano), Matrix 1S AIO P1 HD FC
    • HGLRC Draco
    • TJRC VTX, XJRC XJ3D Goggles, XJRC 02L Goggles
    • More coming soon!

The LiteRadio 4 and LiteRadio 4 Neo redefine entry-level radio transmitter, offering professional 10-channel operation in an ultra-portable package perfect for new pilots. With two new dedicated trim switches for instant mid-flight adjustments, both deliver razor-sharp control whether you're flying drones, mastering drone soccer, robot or fixed wing. The advanced-coated gimbals deliver silky-smooth, durable operation for seamless simulator training across PCs, tablets, and mobile devices. Built for endurance, the built-in 1S 1000mAh (LiteRadio 4 Neo) / 2000mAh (LiteRadio 4) battery powers 8+ hours (at 25mW) of flight or practice and recharges quickly via 15W fast charging.

From your first simulator sessions to real-world flight mastery, both variants combine durable construction with intuitive operation, proving you don't need complexity to achieve professional-grade precision. The perfect launchpad for your radio control journey.

    Bullet Points

    • Ergonomic Portability: Lightweight design offers all-day comfort for training or travel.
    • 10-Channel Customization: Two new tactile switches expand output channels to 10, enabling more flexible controls for drones, robots, drone soccer, and fixed-wing models.
    • 5D Trim Adjustments: Two dedicated trim switches allow pilots to effortlessly fine-tune joystick offsets mid-flight for instant balancing.
    • Advanced-Coated Gimbal Sensor: Anti-wear coating ensures smooth, accurate stick movement with better durability.
    • Fast-Charging Battery: Built-in 1S 1000mAh (LiteRadio 4 Neo) / 2000mAh (LiteRadio 4) battery delivers 8+ hours of runtime at 25mW, with 15W chargings.
    • Latest LiteRadio Transmitter: Incorporates BETAFPV’s advanced radio transmission technology for reliable, low-latency control.

    Enhanced Control & Precision at Your Fingertips

    The LiteRadio 4 and LiteRadio 4 Neo elevate pilot mastery with advanced-coated gimbal sensor, two tactile switches and trim switches. 10 output channels now offer more advanced customization with responsive and ergonomic handling, while the trim switches offer 4-directional adjustments with central-tap reset capability - enabling instant in-flight balancing when it matters most. Combined with the advanced-coated gimbal sensor—optimized for silky responsiveness and extended durability—the LiteRadio 4 transforms complex tasks into intuitive actions.

    Whether mastering drone, robot, drone soccer, or fixed wing, its enhanced functionality ensures pilots enjoy unparalleled responsiveness and adaptability. Every input is sharper, Every adjustment effortless.

    Start Small, Control Big

    The LiteRadio 4 and LiteRadio 4 Neo pack professional-grade control into a remarkably compact form. Small enough for your backpack yet powerful enough for competition, its lightweight design doesn’t sacrifice durability—making it the perfect companion for training at home, at the field, or anywhere inspiration strikes.

    All Your Favorite FPV Simulators, One Controller

    Experience the ultimate flexibility with LiteRadio 4 and LiteRadio 4 Neo, your gateway to popular FPV simulators like VelociDrone, Liftoff, TRYP, Erea Drone, DRL, DCL, DJI, etc. Whether you're on a desktop, Android device, or tablet, it ensures smooth compatibility across all platforms. With the added Xbox mode, enjoy effortless integration with the DJI Flight Simulator on Windows system and elevate your virtual flying experience to new heights.

The new LiteRadio 4 Neo, equipped with a built-in 1S 1000mAh battery, offers the same impressive endurance. When it's time to recharge, upgraded 15W fast charging gets the LiteRadio 4 back to full in just 40 minutes, while the Neo reaches 100% in only 30 minutes—so you spend less time waiting and more time flying.

    LiteRadio 4 — Train Wirelessly On Any Simulator, Anywhere

    The LiteRadio 4 transforms pilot training with its Bluetooth Joystick Mode, offering instant wireless connectivity to FPV simulators across PCs, mobile devices, and tablets. Hone your skills in lifelike environments—no cables, no hassle. Furthermore, the Xbox Mode delivers integration with DJI Virtual Flight, offering the most authentic DJI training experience outside actual flight. Perfect your maneuvers in hyper-realistic aerial simulations, bridging the gap between practice and real-world performance.

    Note: Bluetooth connectivity is available only on the LiteRadio 4. The LiteRadio 4 Neo does not support Bluetooth.

    Evolving Excellence: The LiteRadio Series

    From the original LiteRadio 1 to the advanced LiteRadio 4, BETAFPV’s LiteRadio series has redefined compact, high-performance radio transmitters. Now, the LiteRadio 4 elevates the series with 10-channel output, dual trim switches, and 15W fast charging, making it the most versatile and precise transmitter in the lineup. Each iteration in the LiteRadio lineage demonstrates BETAFPV's dedication to innovation, delivering increasingly sophisticated performance while maintaining the accessible, user-friendly design that made the original so popular.

Building on the proven durability and performance of its predecessor, the Meteor75 Pro II takes the legendary 1S whoop to the next level. Featuring the all-new optimized II frame with aerodynamic refinements and tough construction, it delivers exceptional crash resistance and flight efficiency. Powered by the Freestyle 1102 Motors (2026) with 15% higher efficiency and a 6.33:1 thrust-to-weight ratio, paired with the advanced Matrix 1S 5IN1 II FC, this whoop offers explosive power and agile handling for both indoor and outdoor flying. Extended flight times of up to 11.5 minutes give you more air time to capture the perfect shot, while the ultra-wide 173° FOV Air Camera in 16:9 aspect ratio provides immersive, crystal-clear FPV vision for confident flying. Whether you're a beginner learning the basics or an experienced pilot pushing freestyle limits, the Meteor75 Pro II is built to perform—and built to last.

Bullet Points

  • Exceptional Durability: Tough II frame and anti-crash design make it ideal for daily training and micro aerial photography.
  • Optimized II Frame: Aerodynamic design with arm braces refined from 6 to 5 and curved whoop duct reduces weight and air resistance for improved flight efficiency, with tough construction for exceptional durability.
  • Lightweight Design: Weighing only 27.98g—2g lighter than the previous version—for a more agile and responsive flying experience.
  • 15% Higher Power Efficiency: Freestyle 1102 Motors (2026) with 2000 series alloy rotor housing and improved slot fill factor delivers a 6.33:1 thrust-to-weight ratio and superior efficiency paired with GF 1811 3-Blade Props.
  • 11.5-Min Extended Flight Time: Achieves 10.5 minutes with LAVA II 1S 580mAh batteries and 11.5 minutes with 680mAh batteries—more time to capture the perfect shot.
  • Matrix 1S 5IN1 II FC: Integrates 12A continuous ESC and ELRS 2.4G RX with 3-point crash-proof mounting and 1.0mm thickened PCB for enhanced durability and strong burst capability.
  • Ultra-Wide 173° FOV Air Camera: 16:9 aspect ratio delivers 33% more horizontal view than standard 4:3, with a glass lens for sharper, scratch-resistant video quality.

Weighing only 5.80g—nearly 2g lighter than the previous version—and built tough to withstand crashes, the frame offers an agile flying experience and exceptional durability, making Meteor75 Pro II the ideal choice for both indoor and outdoor flights.

Powerful Propulsion System

Powered by the Freestyle 1102 Motors (2026), featuring an upgraded 2000 series alloy outer rotor housing material and a reinforced shaft design built to withstand the hardest impacts. Achieving 15% higher efficiency through improved slot fill factor, these motors deliver more power output and smoother throttle response when paired with GF 1811 3-Blade Props. With the LAVA II 1S 580mAh batteries, the Meteor75 Pro II achieves up to 10.5 minutes of flight time and a 6.33:1 thrust-to-weight ratio—giving you extended sessions to capture the perfect shot. For even longer flights, the 680mAh batteries extend air time up to 11.5 minutes.

Matrix 1S 5IN1 II Flight Controller

With the raw power of a 12A continuous and peak 18A ESC, the Matrix 1S 5IN1 II sufficiently meets the power demands of the Freestyle 1102 Motors, providing strong burst capability for the Meteor75 Pro II. Crash-proof confidence comes from 3-point mounting that creates cushioning space during impacts, while the 1.0mm thickened PCB and optimized layout further enhance crash resilience for long-lasting reliability.

    Ultra-Wide 173° FOV Air Camera

    Equipped with the Air Camera in 16:9 aspect ratio, it delivers 33% more horizontal view than standard 4:3, paired with a 173° ultra-wide FOV—so you can see more through every corner and react faster. Inside, a new CMOS sensor ensures stable color rendition while running cooler, maintaining consistent performance flight after flight. The glass lens delivers sharper video quality and stands up to scratches better than plastic. Whether threading gates or diving gaps, the Air Camera gives you a clearer, wider, and truer view of the action.

The P1 HD VRX (Standard) is a digital video receiver compatible with the ArtLynk Protocol, designed to bring affordable, crystal‑clear HD FPV to education, training, racing events, and professional presentations. Simply connect it via the mini HDMI port to external displays or goggles, and enjoy a stunning 1080p@60fps live feed with low latency and reliable 400m+ range. With a built‑in 1/4" tripod nut and an integrated cooling fan, the P1 VRX Standard is built for long‑operation both indoors and outdoors – making it the perfect choice for professional monitoring and live viewing.

Bullet Points

  • Mini HDMI Output: Connect to external displays or goggles for training, racing, and presentations
  • 1080p@60fps HD Video: Smooth, low‑latency transmission with 400m+ reliable range
  • 1/4" Tripod Mount: Stable setup for outdoor events and field use
  • Built‑In Cooling Fan: Reliable performance during extended operation
  • Multi‑Band Switching: Interference‑free performance in crowded RF environments

  • Weight (antenna excluded): 70.5g

  • Frequency: 5.3-5.8GHz

    Diagram

    Note: The Type-C port is designed for firmware updates only. It does not support power input or video output.

    Dimensions

    Mini HDMI Output for HD Presentation

    The P1 VRX Standard connects to external displays or goggles via its mini HDMI port for clear, real‑time HD viewing. Whether you're coaching a student, presenting to an audience, or monitoring a race, it ensures everyone sees the action in crisp 1080p detail – making it the perfect tool for professional and educational environments.

    Built for Long‑Operation & Outdoor Use

    Engineered for reliability, the P1 VRX Standard features a built‑in cooling fan to prevent overheating during extended sessions. The 1/4" tripod nut allows for stable mounting, making it ideal for outdoor events and field use.

    Smooth, Reliable Video Transmission

    The P1 HD VRX supports 1080p@60fps video transmission with a stable 400m+ range and low latency for a smooth, immersive flying experience. Operating across the 5.3–5.8GHz frequency range, it allows you to switch channels to avoid interference, ensuring optimal transmission range and image quality even in crowded RF environments.

    Know More About ArtLynk Protocol

    The ArtLynk protocol is a low-latency, long-range communication protocol for drones, offering superior stability and range over traditional analog VTX. ArtLynk protocol enables real-time HD video at about 60ms latency from glass to glass, which is crucial for smooth flight control and high-quality FPV (First Person View). Here are the key features you may want to know.

    • Artosyn Inside & KAP Supported: ArtLynk protocol uses the Artosyn's latest AR803X chipset, with core technology support provided by KAP (KAP company provides core technology support or product solution to all FPV companies and ensures compatibility for various FPV products using Artosyn chipsets).
    • Collaborative and Open Community: ArtLynk protocol is a collaborative FPV ecosystem not belonging to ONLY one company. Many FPV enterprises and teams would design and produce their own products based on the ArtLynk protocol, ensuring broad compatibility and fostering community.

    The ArtLynk protocol supports the following devices, letting you customize your own build or simply bind and fly:

    • BETAFPV P1 Air Unit, VR04 HD Goggles, Aquila20 P1, Meteor75 Pro P1, Monitor, P1 HD VRX (Standard), P1 HD VRX (Nano) [Beta Test], Matrix 1S AIO P1 HD FC [Beta Test]
    • HGLRC Draco

products.title: Matrix 1S Brushless Flight Controller (AIO P1 HD VTX)
products.body_html:
We sincerely thank all pilots for their invaluable support and feedback during the Beta Test phase. The final product is now here, also available –  the P1 HD VRX (Nano).

Important Notes:

  1. This FC comes with the onboard P1 Air Unit pre‑flashed with firmware v2.1.2. For compatibility with BETAFPV receivers (P1 VRX Standard, P1 VRX Nano, VR04 HD Goggles, and Monitor), please update them to firmware v2.1.3.

  3. This FC comes with an onboard receiver pre‑flashed with BETAFPV AIO RX V2. Please do not flash other firmware versions. The default version is V3.5.3 – for higher versions, visit the firmware page.
  4. The onboard P1 Air Unit may generate additional heat. Please avoid keeping the whoop powered on for extended periods without active flight.
  5. When flying the Meteor75 Pro with 1102 motors, be mindful of temperature warnings during flight.

Experience the lightest digital 1S flight controller – the Matrix 1S AIO P1 HD FC. Weighing just 4.60g, this fully integrated board combines the STM32G473 flight controller, continuous 12A ESC, Serial ELRS 2.4G receiver, and P1 Air Unit VTX into a single, compact unit – making it easier than ever to build and maintain your digital whoop. Enjoy a cost‑effective, lightweight, and plug‑and‑play digital FPV experience with the Matrix 1S AIO P1 HD FC.

 Attention

  • Flight controllers are covered for manufacturer defects. Issues arising from user errors, physical crash damage, damage during installation or dismantling, modifications, power surges, electrical fires, or water exposure are not covered.

    Bullet Points

    • Lightest Digital FC: Weighs just 4.60g (5.99g with the Air HD Camera), keeping your 1S whoop lightweight and agile.
    • All‑in‑One Integrated Design: Combines STM32G473 FC, 12A ESC, Serial ELRS 2.4G receiver, and P1 Air Unit VTX on a single board.

    Lightest Digital AIO

    The Matrix AIO P1 HD FC integrates the P1 Air Unit HD VTX directly into the board, weighing just 4.60g – making it the lightest digital all‑in‑one flight controller available. Experience crisp, clear HD video without the weight penalty – digital FPV has never been this light.

    Air HD Camera & Coaxial Cable

    To achieve an ultra-light AIO FC, we developed matching components that carry the same weight-saving philosophy. The Air HD Camera weighs just 1.07g, thanks to a slim 0.8mm PCB and a compact design that doesn't sacrifice performance. Its companion coaxial cable is equally streamlined—using just 15 pins to connect the camera to the AIO board, compared to 26 pins on the standard P1 Air Unit cable. The result: less wiring, fewer pins, and a total cable weight of only 0.32g. Both the camera and cable are available separately, so you can build or replace with ease.

    Highly Integration

    The Matrix AIO P1 HD FC combines the STM32G473 flight controller, Bluejay ESC, Serial ELRS 2.4G receiver, and P1 Air Unit VTX into a single, compact board – minimizing wiring and simplifying builds. The STM32G473 MCU runs at 168MHz, delivering excellent computing capacity for responsive flight performance. The powerful ESC features a robust 12A continuous current (18A peak) to meet the high surge demands of 1S digital whoops. Paired with the P1 Air Unit HD VTX, enjoy a 1080p@60fps live feed with approximately 60ms latency – crisp, immersive digital video at an affordable cost.

    Know More About ArtLynk Protocol

    The ArtLynk protocol is a low-latency, long-range communication protocol for drones, offering superior stability and range over traditional analog VTX. ArtLynk protocol enables real-time HD video at about 60ms latency from glass to glass, which is crucial for smooth flight control and high-quality FPV (First Person View). Here are the key features you may want to know.

    • Artosyn Inside & KAP Supported: ArtLynk protocol uses the Artosyn's latest AR803X chipset, with core technology support provided by KAP (KAP company provides core technology support or product solution to all FPV companies and ensures compatibility for various FPV products using Artosyn chipsets).
    • Collaborative and Open Community: ArtLynk protocol is a collaborative FPV ecosystem not belonging to ONLY one company. Many FPV enterprises and teams would design and produce their own products based on the ArtLynk protocol, ensuring broad compatibility and fostering community.

    The ArtLynk protocol supports the following devices, letting you customize your own build or simply bind and fly:

    • BETAFPV P1 Air Unit, VR04 HD Goggles, Aquila20 P1, Meteor75 Pro P1, Monitor, Matrix 1S AIO P1 HD FC, P1 HD VRX (Standard), P1 HD VRX (Nano)
    • HGLRC Draco
    • TJRC VTX, XJRC XJ3D Goggles, XJRC 02L Goggles
    • More coming soon!

    Serial ELRS 2.4G RX

    Serial ELRS 2.4G RX uses the Crossfire serial protocol (CRSF protocol) to communicate between the receiver and the flight controller board. So the Serial ELRS 2.4G RX is available to support upgrading to ELRS V3.0 with no need to flash Betaflight flight controller firmware. Enter binding status by power on/off three times.

    • Plugin and unplug the flight controller three times;
    • Make sure the RX LED is doing a quick double blink, which indicates the receiver is in bind mode;
    • Make sure the RF TX module or radio transmitter enters binding status, which sends out a binding pulse;
    • If the receiver has a solid light, it's bound.

    The Serial ELRS 2.4G RX can be updated via Wi-Fi or Betaflight serial passthrough. Here is the way to update the Serial ELRS 2.4G RX firmware through passthrough.

    • Plug in your FC to your computer, connect to ExpressLRS Configurator instead of Betaflight Configurator;
    • Choose target "BETAFPV 2.4G AIO V2 RX" (To achieve a compact and lightweight AIO P1 HD FC, we upgraded to the latest ESP8685 chip in a space-saving 4×4mm package — from the 5×5mm ESP8285 used on the Matrix 5IN1 II FC. It features a 160MHz CPU, 400KB SRAM, and 4MB flash, delivering faster processing and reliable performance in a smaller footprint);
    • Flash using the BetaflightPassthrough option in ExpressLRS Configurator.

    How to flash firmware via Wi-Fi here.

    Bluejay ESC Firmware

    With BB51 ESC solution, Matrix 1S Brushless Flight Controller is based on A_X_5_96KHz_V0.19.hex for BB51 Bluejay hardware, it supports D-shot300, D-shot600, and even RPM filtering in Betaflight, offers 24KHz, 48KHz, and 96KHz fixed PWM frequency for options, and custom start-up melodies.

    DO NOT flash the firmware with a shorter interval, otherwise, there will be a certain chance of stalling and burning the flight controller.

    • ESC-Configurator: https://preview.esc-configurator.com/
    • Download BLHeliSuite16714903
    • Download the Bluejay ESC firmware. Please choose A_X_5_96KHz_V0.19.hex

    ESC Configuration

    This flight controller has Bluejay 96kHz firmware by default. If you experience motor startup issues, adjust the Minimum Startup Power (Boost) and Maximum Startup Power (Protection) parameters using the ESC Configurator. Refer to the table below for recommended values.

    How to Use Serial Ports, Intergrated RX and VTX

    Please note that by default, UART3 is connected to the RX and UART4 is connected to the HD VTX. Additionally, this FC reserves 1 complete full-featured serial ports that can be used for external CRSF/SBUS receivers, GPS, or other serial devices. You can refer to the below pictures.

products.title: NexRadio Gimbal
products.body_html:
We sincerely thank all pilots for your invaluable support and feedback during the Beta Test phase. The final product is now here, featuring the following upgrades:

  • Throttle Friction: Refined the structure, materials, and mold precision of the friction module. Added heat-shrink tube to the metal leaf spring and applied specially formulated PFPE/PTFE damping grease for a consistently smooth feel and extended lifespan.
  • Softer Self-centering: Based on your feedback, a softer spring is now fitted as the default. The original beta test spring is also included in the package for pilots who prefer a crisp feel.
  • Sensor Protection: Optimized the shield for the digital sensor to better protect against humidity and improve long-term stability in demanding environments.
  • Smart Sampling Rate: Added smart sampling to take full advantage of the NexRadio DCS Gimbal. The gimbal's sampling rate now automatically synchronizes with the RF packet rate at up to 1 kHz for consistent response.
  • Looking Ahead: Radio controllers vary widely in structure, circuitry, and hardware, and we will continue to expand and optimize our solutions. We've also heard your requests for custom colors, CNC materials, and more. Our engineers have considered DIY customization and expandability in the design. Stay tuned for future updates.
  • Important Safety Notice: The DCS Gimbal operates at 3.3V. Do not connect it to a 5V power supply, as this will cause permanent damage.

The NexRadio 14 Radio Controller BETA TEST is now alive! Click to learn more details.

As the first RC gimbal to feature the DCS (Digital Capacitive Sensor), the NexRadio Gimbal delivers silky-smooth control, exceptional inteference immunity, and a virtually unlimited lifespan. With smart sampling rate at up to 1 kHz, 13-bit sampling depth and 8K resolution, it introduces a third generation of RC gimbal technology, following potentiometer and Hall gimbals.

    Bullet Points

    • The first RC gimbal to feature the DCS.
    • Smart Sampling Rate: Gimbal's sampling rate automatically synchronizes with the RF packet rate at up to 1 kHz.
    • Ultra-high Precision: Superior linearity, 8K resolution, symmetrical actuation force, and independent calibration deliver superior control.
    • Anti-Interference: All digital signal path and magnetic-field-independent capacitive sensing for uncompromised precision.
    • Infinite Lifespan: Contactless capacitive sensing ensures a fluid feel and near-infinite operational life.

    Specifications

    • Item: NexRadio Gimbal
    • Sensor: DCS
    • Sampling depth: 13-bit
    • Resolution: 8K
    • Sensor lifespan: Virtually unlimited
    • Communication interface: UART
    • Operating voltage: 3.3V
    • Travel adjustment range: 24° / 27° / 30°
    • Y-axis centering mode toggle: Supported
    • Centering tension adjustment: Supported
    • Throttle damping adjustment: Supported
    • Throttle detent adjustment: Supported
    • Stick end: M4
    • Dimensions: 54.2*52.2*33.2mm
    • Mounting hole size: 45.2*40.5*49.9 mm
    • Weight: c. 85g/set
    • Compatible radio controllers: NexRadio Series Radio Controller, RadioMaster TX16 / TX15 / Boxer

    Advanced DCS Gimbal

    Built on the advanced DCS sensor, the NexRadio DCS Gimbal marks a new generation of gimbal.

    Smart Sampling at up to 1 kHz

    Under the V1 protocol, traditional digital gimbals output data at a fixed 500 Hz, while ELRS RF packet rates range from 50 Hz to 1 kHz. This mismatch can cause repeated gimbal data across RF packets. The NexRadio DCS Gimbal now meets the requirements of the V2 protocol, enabling smart sampling at up to 1 kHz. It automatically matches the ELRS RF packet rate for synchronized, responsive control.

    Ultra-high Precision

    With 13-bit sampling depth and 8K resolution, the NexRadio DCS Gimbal provides the instantaneous, pure, and precise response demanded by discerning pilots.

    Compared to Hall sensors, the inherent linearity of capacitive sensing minimizes the need for extensive post-processing, filtering, or calibration.

    Precisely engineered geometry ensures balanced actuation forces across both axes for a consistent feel and smooth control.

    Rather than applying generic factory profiles, every sensor undergoes individual dynamic calibration after full mechanical assembly. This eliminates stack-up tolerances and guarantees flawless electrical-to-mechanical centering for each unique unit.

    Anti-Interference

    The capacitive sensor operates entirely independently of magnetic fields, rendering it immune to the electromagnetic interference that plagues Hall gimbals. Its end-to-end digital signal path further eliminates the noise and ripple inherent to conventional analog voltage outputs. Whether operating alongside high-power RF transmitters or within complex electromagnetic environments, the NexRadio DCS Gimbal maintains unwavering precision.

    Infinite Lifespan

    Traditional potentiometers lose centering accuracy and linearity over time due to mechanical wear. The DCS sensor, however, captures position data without physical contact—detecting capacitance changes as the medium rotates. This contactless design ensures a consistently smooth, fluid feel with a virtually unlimited operational lifespan.

    The Ultimate Evolution of Gimbal Sensors

    Moving beyond the mechanical wear of potentiometers and the magnetic interfere limitations of hall-effect sensors, the digital capacitive gimbal sets a new industry benchmark.

    Sensor Type Potentiometer Analog Hall Digital Hall Digital Capacitive
    Detection Principle Resistive voltage division Magnetic field strength Magnetic field vector angle Differential capacitance
    Signal Transmission Analog voltage Analog voltage Digital signal Digital signal
    Resolution 12-bit 12-bit 12-bit 13-bit

    Lifespan 500K-1M cycles Virtually unlimited Virtually unlimited Virtually unlimited
    Centering Accuracy Poor Moderate Moderate Excellent
    Linearity Performance Degrades with mechanical wear Requires software calibration Requires software calibration Inherently superior
    Temperature Drift Resistance Poor Poor Moderate Excellent

    The Matrix Brushed Flight Controller is available in two versions: 5IN1 and 4IN1. The 5IN1 integrates flight controller, brushed ESC, VTX, serial ELRS receiver, OSD, and Blackbox for easy installation and maintenance. The high‑quality 400mW 5.8GHz VTX delivers precise and stable frequency, meeting the demands of racing while being perfectly suitable for everyday flight. And the 4IN1 retains a port for an external VTX, giving you the freedom to use your preferred video transmitter.

    12A Brushed ESC with Turtle Mode

    The onboard ESC provides 12A continuous (18A peak) output and supports 1‑2S battery operation. Turtle Mode is also available — after a crash, simply flip the drone over and continue flying.

    Turtle Mode Instructions:

    1. In Betaflight, go to the Modes tab and find "FLIP OVER AFTER CRASH".
    2. Assign an AUX channel (AUX4 by default) and set the activation range.
    3. After a crash, enable the Turtle Mode switch, then arm the motors. Use your radio to flip the drone over.
    4. Disable Turtle Mode, then re‑arm the motors to resume normal flight.

    Enhanced MCU Performance

    The MCU has been upgraded from the STM32F411 (used in the F4 1S 5A FC) to the latest STM32G473C, resulting in a 55% increase in computing speed. This means smoother control response and a more locked‑in flight experience.

    Serial ELRS 2.4G RX

    Serial ELRS 2.4G RX uses the Crossfire serial protocol (CRSF protocol) to communicate between the receiver and the flight controller board.     • Plugin and unplug the flight controller three times;
    • Make sure the RX LED is doing a quick double blink, which indicates the receiver is in bind mode;
    • Make sure the RF TX module or radio transmitter enters binding status, which sends out a binding pulse;
    • If the receiver has a solid light, it's bound.

    The Serial ELRS 2.4G RX can be updated via Wi-Fi or Betaflight serial passthrough. Here is the way to update the Serial ELRS 2.4G RX firmware through passthrough.

    • Plug in your FC to your computer, connect to ExpressLRS Configurator instead of Betaflight Configurator;
    • Choose target "BETAFPV 2.4GHz AIO RX";
    • Flash using the BetaflightPassthrough option in ExpressLRS Configurator.

    How to flash firmware via Wi-Fi here.

    Please note that by default UART3 is connected to the RX. To release UART3, please remove the resistor. The powerful yet compact HD whoop drone features the advanced P1 Air Unit HD VTX, delivering stunning 1080p digital video, smooth 60ms low‑latency transmission, and an impressive range of up to 400 meters. Whether you're a novice or a seasoned pilot, this kit offers exceptional performance, durability, and clarity – giving you the confidence to explore both indoor and outdoor environments with ease.

Bullet Points

  • HD Digital Video: Equipped with the P1 Air Unit VTX for 1080p/60fps smooth, low‑latency (~60ms) transmission up to 400m.

  • All‑in‑One Ready‑to‑Fly Kit: Includes Meteor75 Pro P1 drone, VR04 HD goggles, LiteRadio 4 SE radio transmitter, and a portable carry bag.
  • Comfortable VR04 HD Goggles: Glasses‑friendly design, contoured padding, 2600mAh batteries (3‑hour runtime), and one‑button 1080p recording to microSD card.
  • LiteRadio 4 SE Radio Transmitter: 8‑channel, smooth gimbal, Bluetooth for simulator training, and 2000mAh battery with 8+ hours of use.
  • Built for Durability & Portability: Rugged whoop frame and included carry bag make it easy to take anywhere and survive inevitable crashes.

    P1 Air Unit HD VTX

    The Meteor75 Pro HD FPV Kit features the advanced P1 Air Unit HD VTX, which provides crisp 1080p digital video with a powerful 200mW output and a reliable range of 400 meters. Enjoy a smooth flying experience with a low latency of approximately 60ms, ensuring stable, static-free HD video for confident exploration and an immersive FPV experience.

    Complete Kit, Portable & Ready to Fly

    This all-in-one kit includes the robust Meteor75 Pro P1 whoop, VR04 HD goggles, and LiteRadio 4 SE radio transmitter—everything you need to start flying FPV immediately. Additionally, a custom portable bag is included for safe transport to the field, races, or vacations. Simply unbox and take to the skies in minutes.

    Largest & Powerful 1S HD Whoop

    With an 80.8mm wheelbase, the Meteor75 Pro P1 is the largest and most powerful 1S HD whoop on the market. It boasts precise, agile flight dynamics, powered by 1102 21000KV / 18000KV motors and the LAVA II 1S 580mAh battery. This combination provides an excellent thrust-to-weight ratio, allowing for powerful climbs, tight turns, and flight times of up to 5.5 minutes—ideal for both indoor cruising and outdoor freestyle maneuvers.

Its advanced-coated gimbal delivers silky-smooth, durable operation, paired with Bluetooth wireless modes for seamless simulator training across PCs, tablets, and mobile devices. Diagram

Total Immersion & Comfort

The VR04 FPV Goggles are designed for extended-wear comfort, featuring a glasses-friendly interior that accommodates most eyewear. Premium PU face padding ensures a secure, comfortable fit, while a soft silicone nose bridge seals out external light to deliver a fully immersive flight experience.

Power Flexibility

Equipped with a built-in 2000mAh battery, the VR04 supports up to 2 hours of use on a single charge. For added flexibility, it can also be powered directly by any 2‑6S whoop battery—ideal for extended sessions or quick-swap setups.

Record & Replay

Capture each flight effortlessly with one-button recording directly to a microSD card (supports up to 64GB of storage). Relive your most thrilling moments anytime, with no extra gear required.

How to Record A Video?

  • Insert a microSD card into the card slot, FAT32 format only and maximum 64G;
  • Short press the record button once, a red dot will appear in the upper left corner. Then there will be a "beep-beep" sound from FPV goggles;
  • Wait for 8 seconds, the red dot and the recording LED indicator will start flashing. At the same time, a timer appears on the screen, indicating the start of recording;
  • To stop the recording, short press the record button once again. After 2-3 seconds, the red dot on the upper left corner stop flashing, the timer disappears, and the red record LED indicator turns off.

Notes: 
1. After pressing the record button, the DVR recording function will take about 8-10 seconds to be activated, please wait in patience.
2. The maximum length of each recording is 10 minutes. When a recording exceeds 10 minutes, a new recording file will be created automatically.

The VR04 FPV Goggles support 5.8G and 48 channels. Press and hold the 5D button for 2-3 seconds to activate frequency search. There will be a beep after 3 seconds, and the best available frequency will be selected automatically. Signal quality of each frequency is indicated by red, yellow and green.

  • Green (0<RSSI<20): Frequency is available.
  • Yellow (20<RSSI<70): Frequency has moderate interference from another transmitter.
  • Red (70<RSSI): Frequency is completely in use by a transmitter.
  • White: The strongest signal which the goggles received in this scan.

products.title: Air75 II Brushless Whoop Quadcopter
products.body_html:
Engineered for the next generation of 1S performance, the Air75 II redefines the balance of power and resilience. At its core, a specialized propulsion system offers three distinct configurations—Champion, Racing, and Freestyle—each tuned with specific motor and propeller combinations for optimized thrust, response, and control. This precision-tuned power is matched by a rugged, purpose-built design, featuring the durable Matrix 5IN1 II Flight Controller with a high-output 12A ESC and a reinforced frame & canopy crafted to withstand repeated impacts. Built to deliver relentless performance in every flying style, the Air75 II is the ultralight whoop that doesn’t hold back.

Note: Due to the shortage of IMU chip ICM42688, BETAFPV team has found new IMU chips including ICM42622, BMI270, and LSM6DSK320X, and built compatible firmwares. Extensive testing confirms they all meet our strict quality standards.

Betaflight has not yet released official firmwares compatible with some of the IMU chips, so please do not flash the official Betaflight firmware and pay attention to future support updates.

Bullet Points

  • Three Performance-Tuned Versions: Choose the setup that fits your style.
    • Champion: Max-power 0802 28000KV motors & GF 1614 3-B Props for pro racing.
    • Racing: 0802 25000KV motors & GF 1614 3-B Props for razor-sharp throttle response on technical courses.
    • Freestyle: 0802 22000KV motors & GF 1614 3-B Props for smooth, efficient, and cinematic flying.
  • 0802 Brushless Motors (2026): Feature a revolutionary 0.1mm stator core, specific magnetic and winding designs for Champion, Racing and Freestyle versions.
  • Matrix 5IN1 II FC: Features a robust 12A continuous ESC, 3-point mounting, and a 1.0mm thickened PCB for superior power and resilience.
  • Air II Canopy: Features upgraded materials, strategic reinforcements and a redesigned curve with a 15° to 45° adjustable camera angle.
  • Air75 II Frame: Its optimized ducts, connecting braces, and PP blend ensure stable, reliable flights.
  • Lightweight & Flight Time: An ultra-lightweight design achieves up to 7:30 flight time with the LAVA II 1S 480mAh battery.

    Three Propulsion Systems

    The Air75 II expands its lineup with three distinct performance profiles: Champion, Racing, and Freestyle. Each version is powered by new 0802 brushless motors, featuring an industry-first 0.1mm stator core, specific magnetic and winding designs for superior efficiency and power. Combined with the new GF 1614 3-blade props and driven by the high-output Matrix 1S 5IN1 II Flight Controller—with a 12A continuous (18A peak) ESC—this system is built to reliably meet extreme current demands.

    The Champion is equipped with dual‑ball bearing Champion 0802 Motors (28000KV) for maximum power, achieving an exceptional 7.1:1 thrust‑to‑weight ratio for explosive acceleration and track dominance. The Racing features Racing 0802 Motors (25000KV) tuned for razor‑sharp throttle response and agility on technical courses. The Freestyle utilizes Freestyle 0802 Motors (22000KV) optimized for smooth control, superior low‑end torque, and efficient, fluid flying.

    Durability

    Flight Controller

    The Matrix 1S 5IN1 II FC employs a 3-point mounting system that creates cushioning space during impacts, reducing stress on core components and lowering the damage rate by up to 80%. Its 1.0mm thickened PCB and optimized layout further enhance crash resilience.

    New Canopy & Frame

    Every version is built on the same foundation: the Air II Canopy and the Air75 II Frame, featuring strategic reinforcements and upgraded materials. This combination ensures consistent durability and reliable performance in every flight.

    Community Feedback

    In direct response to valuable discussions within the FPV community regarding the durability of Air 5IN1 FC, we conducted a poll across the Tiny Whoop and BETAFPV Facebook groups. The results were clear: over 50% of pilots prioritized improved crash resilience in the Air Series. This feedback became our central design goal for the Air75 II.

    Learn more about the poll: https://www.facebook.com/groups/tinywhoop/posts/4292951027592546/

    To develop an effective solution, our R&D team evaluated multiple design approaches. Tests indicated that removing a rubber grommet could significantly improve impact protection. To validate this finding, we executed a systematic crash test protocol, comparing the new configuration directly against previous designs.

    • Air Whoops Tested:
    1. Air65 (Air 5IN1 FC): With 4 rubber grommets.
    2. Air65 (Air 5IN1 FC): With the front rubber grommet removed.
    3. Air65 II (Matrix 1S 5IN1 II): With the front rubber grommet removed.
    4. Air75 II (Matrix 1S 5IN1 II): With the front rubber grommet removed.
    • Method:

    Each unit was accelerated 5 meters in a straight line at level flight throttle and crashed horizontally into a wall. Image transmission, OSD, and receiver signals were monitored after each impact. The test concluded after 20 crashes or upon observed failure.

    • Test Results:
    Configuration Tested Units Tested FCs Damaged After 20 Crashes Failure Rate Key Observations
    Air65 Racing (4 grommets) 5 5 100% All FCs failed.
    Air65 Racing (3 grommets) 5 1 20% One OSD failure at crash 16; others operational.
    Air65 II Racing (3 grommets) 4 0 0% No failures; no significant deformation.
    Air75 II Racing (3 grommets) 4 2 50% Mixed results; two FCs remained operational.

    • The Engineering Solution:

    The data was conclusive: removing the front rubber grommet dramatically reduced stress transfer to the flight controller, lowering the risk of crash-related FC damage by approximately 80%, with negligible impact on flight performance. We took this further in the Air75 II by fully integrating a 3-point mounting system. When combined with the new Matrix 1S 5IN1 II’s 1.0mm thickened PCB and internal reinforcements, the result is a significantly more resilient whoop.

    Precision-Tuned Flying Experience

    Every component, from the motor and propeller combination to the flight controller parameters, is meticulously calibrated for each version. This results in three distinct flying characters: the smooth, efficient Freestyle, the razor-sharp Racing, and the max-power Champion—ensuring an optimized experience for every pilot and environment.

  • 0702 Brushless Motors (2026): Feature a revolutionary 0.1mm stator core, specific magnetic and winding designs for Champion, Racing and Freestyle versions.
  • Matrix 5IN1 II FC: Features a robust 12A continuous ESC, 3-point mounting, and a 1.0mm thickened PCB for superior power and resilience.
  • Air II Canopy: Features upgraded materials, strategic reinforcements and a redesigned curve with a 15° to 45° adjustable camera angle.

    Three Propulsion Systems

    Engineered for next-gen performance, the Air65 II is offered in three distinct versions: Champion, Racing, and Freestyle. Each is defined by purpose-built 0702 brushless motors, featuring a revolutionary 0.1mm stator core and a specific magnetic/winding design. To power these demanding setups, all versions are equipped with the Matrix 1S 5IN1 II Flight Controller, featuring a robust 12A continuous (18A peak) ESC to meet high surge currents.

    Champion

    The Champion version returns as the flagship model, built for pure, professional-grade racing. Weighing only 16.6g, it features the exclusive 2.20g Air65 Champion Frame and the unsoldered Matrix 5IN1 II FC. Equipped with dual-ball bearing Champion 0702 Motors (36000KV) and lightweight GF 1207 3-Blade Props, it achieves an impressive 6.3:1 thrust-to-weight ratio for maximum acceleration and track dominance.

    Racing & Freestyle

    The Racing version features Racing 0702 Motors (30000KV) paired with GF 1207 3-Blade Props. This combination delivers higher RPMs and razor-sharp throttle response for agility on technical race courses. The Freestyle version is equipped with Freestyle 0702 Motors (25000KV) and GF 1219S 3-Blade Props. Optimized for smooth control and superior low-throttle torque, it enables fluid, cinematic flying.

    Durability

    Flight Controller

    The Matrix 1S 5IN1 II FC employs a 3-point mounting system that creates cushioning space during impacts, reducing stress on core components and lowering the damage rate by up to 80%. Its 1.0mm thickened PCB and optimized layout further enhance crash resilience.

    New Canopy & Frame

    All versions feature the crash-resistant Air II Canopy with upgraded materials and strategic reinforcements. The Racing and Freestyle models use the durable Air65 II Frame, while the Champion employs the ultra-light Air65 Champion Frame, both designed with optimized ducts and impact-absorbing PP material to withstand brutal crashes.

    Community Feedback

    In direct response to valuable discussions within the FPV community regarding the durability of Air 5IN1 FC, we conducted a poll across the Tiny Whoop and BETAFPV Facebook groups. The results were clear: over 50% of pilots prioritized improved crash resilience in the Air Series. This feedback became our central design goal for the Air65 II.

    Learn more about the poll: https://www.facebook.com/groups/tinywhoop/posts/4292951027592546/

    To develop an effective solution, our R&D team evaluated multiple design approaches.  Tests indicated that removing a rubber grommet could significantly improve impact protection. To validate this finding, we executed a systematic crash test protocol, comparing the new configuration directly against previous designs.

    • Air Whoops Tested:
    1. Air65 (Air 5IN1 FC): With 4 rubber grommets.
    2. Air65 (Air 5IN1 FC): With the front rubber grommet removed.
    3. Air65 II (Matrix 1S 5IN1 II): With the front rubber grommet removed.
    4. Air75 II (Matrix 1S 5IN1 II): With the front rubber grommet removed.
    • Method:

    Each unit was accelerated 5 meters in a straight line at level flight throttle and crashed horizontally into a wall. Image transmission, OSD, and receiver signals were monitored after each impact. The test concluded after 20 crashes or upon observed failure.

    • Test Results:
    Configuration Tested Units Tested FCs Damaged After 20 Crashes Failure Rate Key Observations
    Air65 Racing (4 grommets) 5 5 100% All FCs failed.
    Air65 Racing (3 grommets) 5 1 20% One OSD failure at crash 16; others operational.
    Air65 II Racing (3 grommets) 4 0 0% No failures; no significant deformation.
    Air75 II Racing (3 grommets) 4 2 50% Mixed results; two FCs remained operational.

    • The Engineering Solution:

    The data was conclusive: removing the front rubber grommet dramatically reduced stress transfer to the flight controller, lowering the risk of crash-related FC damage by approximately 80% in the Air65, with negligible impact on flight performance. We took this further in the Air65 II by fully integrating a 3-point mounting system. When combined with the new Matrix 1S 5IN1 II’s 1.0mm thickened PCB and internal reinforcements, the result is a significantly more resilient whoop.

    Precision-Tuned Flying Experience

    Every component, from the motor and propeller combination to the flight controller parameters, is meticulously calibrated for each version. This results in three distinct flying characters: the smooth, efficient Freestyle, the razor-sharp Racing, and the max-power Champion—ensuring an optimized experience for every pilot and environment.

products.title: Matrix 1S Brushless Flight Controller (5IN1 II)
products.body_html:
The Matrix 1S 5IN1 II Brushless Flight Controller is the next-generation flight controller engineered for pilots who refuse to compromise. Building on the proven all-in-one design, it delivers a substantial leap in both performance and durability. Experience the raw power of a 12A continuous ESC, the crash-proof confidence of 3-point mounting, and the build flexibility of Plug & Play or DIY versions. This is the durable, high-output core for your most demanding 1S whoop builds.

Note: Due to the shortage of IMU chip ICM42688, BETAFPV team has found new IMU chips including ICM42622, BMI270, and LSM6DSK320X, and built compatible firmwares. Extensive testing confirms they all meet our strict quality standards.

Betaflight has not yet released official firmwares compatible with some of the IMU chips, so please do not flash the official Betaflight firmware and pay attention to future support updates.

 Attention

  • Flight controllers are covered for manufacturer defects. Issues arising from user errors, physical crash damage, damage during installation or dismantling, modifications, power surges, electrical fires, or water exposure are not covered.
  • VTX Power: Higher VTX power consumes more energy and generates more heat, reducing flight time. For better flight time in indoor scenarios, use 25~100mW power.
  • VTX Antenna: Connect and install the image transmission antenna before powering on the flight control. Alternatively, set transmission power to 0 to avoid burnout.

    Bullet Points

    • All-in-One Integration: Combines the FC, ESC, OSD, Serial ELRS 2.4GHz RX, and a 5.8GHz 400mW VTX into a single, compact unit.
    • Upgraded 12A Continuous ESC: Delivers 12A continuous current (18A peak) for powerful propulsion.
    • Enhanced Durability: Features a robust 3-point mounting system and a 1.0mm thick PCB to absorb crash impacts and protect core components.
    • Flexible Build Options: Available in both Solder-free and Solder-required versions to suit any skill level or weight preference. Features larger solder pads for easier, more reliable custom wiring.
    • Advanced Core Components: Built around a powerful G473 processor for precise racing and complex freestyle maneuvers.
    • Optimized Layout: A refined component arrangement improves durability and overall reliability.

    Specifications

    FC

    • ESC: 12A continuous
    • RX: Serial ELRS 2.4GHz (V3.4.3)
    • VTX: 5.8GHz 48 channels, Max 400mW
    • FC firmware: Betaflight_4.5.3_BETAFPVG473_V2
    • USB port: SH1.0-4Pin
    • Motor connector: JST1.25
    • Battery connector: BT2.0
    • Mounting hole size: 26mm x 26mm
    • Weight: 4.1±0.1g (solder-free), 3.76g (soldered-required)

    ESC

    • Power input: 1S Only
    • Current: 12A continuous, 18A peak
    • ESC firmware: A_X_5_96KHz_V0.19.hex for BB51 Bluejay firmware
    • Digital signal protocol: DShot300, DShot600

    VTX

    • Output power: 25/100/200/400/PIT
    • Frequency: 5.8GHz 48 channels, with Raceband: 5658~5917MHz
    • Channel SEL: SmartAudio2.0
    • Modulation type: FM
    • Frequency control: PLL
    • All harmonic: Max -50dBm
    • Frequency stability: ±100KHz (Typ.)
    • Frequency precision: ±200KHz (Typ.)
    • Channel carrier error: ±1.5dB
    • Antenna port: 50 Ω
    • Operating temperature: -10℃~80℃

    Diagram

    Upgraded 12A Continuous ESC

    The Matrix 5IN1 II features a significantly more powerful ESC, upgraded from 5A to a robust 12A continuous current (18A peak) to meet the high surge demands of 1S whoops. This increase was achieved by integrating 12 MOS tubes directly onto the board through rigorous testing. Paired with gold-plated motor connectors, it ensures superior conductivity and power delivery, providing stronger, more responsive propulsion.

    Enhanced Durability & Crash Protection

    Developed in response to community feedback on crash reliability, the board now features a 3-point mounting system. This design creates essential cushioning space during impacts, reducing stress on core components and lowering the damage rate by up to 80%. Combined with a 1.0mm thickened PCB and an optimized component layout, the Matrix 5IN1 II is built to survive hard crashes.

    Two Build Options: Solder-free Or Solder-required

    To suit different builders, the Matrix 5IN1 II is available in two versions: solder-free and solder-required. The solder-free version has motor connectors and power cable pre-soldered for quick and easy installation, while the solder-required version includes the gold-plated JST1.25 connectors and BT2.0 U cable in the package for custom wiring. Larger solder pads allows direct soldering to save weight.

    Matrix 5IN1 II vs. Matrix 5IN1 vs. Air 5IN1

    All three flight controllers share the same core MCU, OSD, RX, and VTX. The Matrix 5IN1 II is the next-generation balance, blending the durable 1mm-thick board and larger solder pads of the Matrix series with a remarkably lightweight design—adding only 0.16g compared to the Air 5IN1. It stands out with its 12A continuous (18A peak) ESC, gold-plated connectors, and three-point mounting, delivering superior power and the most robust crash protection for high-performance builds.

    Serial ELRS 2.4G RX

    Serial ELRS 2.4G RX uses the Crossfire serial protocol (CRSF protocol) to communicate between the receiver and the flight controller board. So the Serial ELRS 2.4G RX is available to support upgrading to ELRS V3.0 with no need to flash Betaflight flight controller firmware. Enter binding status by power on/off three times.

    • Plugin and unplug the flight controller three times;
    • Make sure the RX LED is doing a quick double blink, which indicates the receiver is in bind mode;
    • Make sure the RF TX module or radio transmitter enters binding status, which sends out a binding pulse;
    • If the receiver has a solid light, it's bound.

    The Serial ELRS 2.4G RX can be updated via Wi-Fi or Betaflight serial passthrough. Here is the way to update the Serial ELRS 2.4G RX firmware through passthrough.

    • Plug in your FC to your computer, connect to ExpressLRS Configurator instead of Betaflight Configurator;
    • Choose target "BETAFPV 2.4GHz AIO RX";
    • Flash using the BetaflightPassthrough option in ExpressLRS Configurator.

    How to flash firmware via Wi-Fi here.

    Betaflight Firmware and CLI

    Betaflight official developers recommend using version 42688 of the gyroscope, and many issues with ICM42688 have been fixed in version 4.5.3. Please learn more from version 4.5.3.

    • FC firmware: Betaflight_4.5.3_BETAFPVG473_V2, download the firmware and CLI dump file
    • Reference link: https://github.com/betaflight/betaflight/releases/tag/4.5.3

    Bluejay ESC Firmware

    With BB51 ESC solution, Matrix 1S Brushless Flight Controller is based on A_X_5_96KHz_V0.19.hex for BB51 Bluejay hardware, it supports D-shot300, D-shot600, and even RPM filtering in Betaflight, offers 24KHz, 48KHz, and 96KHz fixed PWM frequency for options, and custom start-up melodies. 

    DO NOT flash the firmware with a shorter interval, otherwise, there will be a certain chance of stalling and burning the flight controller.

    • ESC-Configurator: https://preview.esc-configurator.com/
    • Download BLHeliSuite16714903
    • Download the Bluejay ESC firmware. Please choose A_X_5_96KHz_V0.19.hex

    How to Use Serial Ports, Intergrated RX and VTX

    Please note that by default, UART2 is connected to the VTX and UART3 is connected to the RX. To release UART3, please remove the resistor. Additionally, this FC reserves 1 complete full-featured serial port that can be used for external CRSF/SBUS receivers, GPS, HD VTX, or other serial devices. You can refer to the picture below.

LAVA 4S Battery vs. LAVA II 4S Battery

Through a core material upgrade, LAVA II 4S Battery unlocks a formidable 95C discharge rate—a 26.7% increase over the previous 75C—delivering a massive boost in available power. This translates into a 0.1V higher and significantly more stable discharge voltage, providing unwavering consistency for peak performance.

Z-Folding Process

The Z-Folding process delivers a superior performance advantage, leveraging its low internal resistance to enable efficient high-current discharge and a 0.2V higher voltage under load compared to wound cells, ensuring consistent and robust power. This architecture also achieves a 5% higher energy density within the same volume and a significantly extended cycle life. Furthermore, it provides unparalleled design freedom, allowing for precise customization of the battery's size and shape to meet specific application requirements, offering broader versatility than traditional winding methods.

Warning

  • Please fully charge the new battery before use.
  • Only use a charger designed for lithium polymer/Li-ion battery, and never leave the battery unattended during the charging process.
  • Always keep the battery away from flammable and explosive materials while charging.
  • Never overcharge the battery. The maximum voltage for a LiPo battery is 4.2V per cell, and for a LiHV battery is 4.35V per cell.
  • Never discharge the battery to a level below 3V per cell under load.
  • Do not store fully charged batteries for more than 3 days. For long-term storage, maintain the voltage between 3.8V and 3.9V.
  • Do not disassemble, crush, short circuit, or expose to flame or other sources of ignition.
  • Do not use batteries that are deformed or swollen.

      Equipped with a 1/2.9” CMOS sensor and a wide 170° field of view, the camera captures vibrant, detailed footage even in varied lighting. See more of your surroundings with clarity that matches the high‑definition transmission—making every flight more immersive and responsive.

      At just 6.5g (antenna excluded), the P1 Air Unit delivers a compact and budget‑friendly HD video solution—so you can build your perfect HD whoop without compromise.
